summary:
• Gemini 4 Hydrogen — an xhigh reasoning tier in the llm‑gemini plugin that yields much longer, more detailed outputs for research assistants and code generation.
• Harness adapters — RL‑trained LoRA‑style add‑ons that specialize a frozen model for a specific harness, raising accuracy and halving token consumption.
• Claude Code — Anthropic’s IDE now integrates enterprise authentication, a chart‑drawing easel mod, and a flexible start‑directory flag, simplifying team deployment and debugging.
• Gezhi‑sheets — a Chinese‑language spreadsheet add‑on that uses LLMs to categorize feedback rows and generate one‑sentence summaries while keeping data locally encrypted.
• MR Office — open‑source browser editors for Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF that provide full‑fidelity editing and real‑time co‑editing without desktop software.
• GPT‑6 Astra — OpenAI’s model used by Hebbia’s Matrix to improve source‑selection accuracy and automatically generate citation‑rich presentation slides for financial due‑diligence.
